Merchant City

Tron Theatre

Housed in a beautiful converted church at the heart of the Merchant City, the Tron is Glasgow's home for new writing and independent theatre. With an intimate main stage and a buzzing bar venue, it programmes a mix of Scottish premieres, visiting companies, and its popular scratch series for works-in-development.

Upcoming at Tron Theatre

New Writing

Salt

Tron Theatre Thu, 12 Mar 2026 – Sun, 22 Mar 2026, 7:45pm

A searing debut from Glasgow playwright Rae Morrison about three generations of women on the Ayrshire coast. Grief, resilience, and the tidal pull of home — sharp and deeply felt.

Scratch Night

Tron Scratch Series: Spring

Tron Theatre Wed, 22 Apr 2026, 8:00pm

Three Scottish companies present 20-minute extracts of ambitious new work. This edition features pieces exploring queer joy, urban rewilding, and what it means to belong somewhere.
